common.tagline: Your step-by-step ally, all the way to university
common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a few seconds.

landing.eyebrow: For students applying to universities and scholarships
landing.title: From the first “where do I go?” to the day you land.
landing.lead: Kumo keeps deadlines, exams, scholarships and documents in one place, and each day tells you the one thing that matters. Your family sees your progress; you decide what else.
landing.p1d: Every morning, one card: what to do today, how long it takes and why it matters.
landing.p2d: Every deadline shows where it came from and whether it is confirmed or estimated.
landing.p3d: A clear view for your parents, without seeing what is private.

login.title: Sign in to Kumo
login.lead: Sign in with your email and a password.
login.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
login.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email, like name@gmail.com.
login.devOutbox: Development mode: see the sent email
login.badCredentials: That email and password don’t match.
login.exists: An account with that email already exists. Sign in with your password.
login.shortPassword: The password needs at least 8 characters.

onboarding.nameLead: This is how Kumo greets you. You can change it anytime.
onboarding.tzLead: We use your time zone so every foreign deadline shows in your time.
onboarding.spaceLead: Your whole process lives here. Only you decide who else gets in.

home.lead: Your space is ready. Here are your first steps.
home.importBody: Import a pack with universities, scholarships and deadlines. You see the changes before saving.
home.inviteBody: Your parents will see your progress and can approve expenses. What is private stays yours.
home.noData: No data yet. Start by importing a pack.

import.title: Import data
import.lead: Choose the .json or .csv files from your data folder. You will first see what gets created or updated; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.invalid: We don’t recognise this format. Use the data/ folder or a Kumo pack (.json).

members.title: People with access
members.lead: You decide who sees your process and what they can do.
members.messagePlaceholder: Dad, this way you can see how I’m doing.
members.neverList: Your journal, your wellbeing check-ins or anything you mark private.

roleHelp.guardian: Sees your progress, deadlines and expenses; approves fees. Cannot edit.
roleHelp.mentor: Comments on your list and essays. Does not see your finances.

members.linkReady: Invitation ready. Send them this link.
members.shareText: Follow my road to university with me on Kumo:

invite.title: {inviter} invites you to Kumo
invite.lead: You are invited as {role} to the space “{space}”.
invite.wrongEmail: This invitation is for {email}. Sign in with that email.
invite.expired: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
invite.emailSubject: {inviter} invites you to follow their journey on Kumo
invite.emailBody: {inviter} invites you as {role}. You will see their progress, upcoming deadlines and anything they need from you.

today.overdue: {n, plural, one {was due yesterday} other {was due # days ago}}
today.agendaEmpty: Nothing fixed today. A good day to move forward at your pace.
today.alertVerify: {n, plural, one {# estimated date is} other {# estimated dates are}} due in the next 3 weeks. Check them at the source before they matter.
today.alertOverdue: {n, plural, one {You have # task left from earlier days} other {You have # tasks left from earlier days}}. Move them to another day in one tap.
today.alertCluster: {n} important things land within 3 days. Pull one forward this week and you’ll arrive calm.
today.emptyBody: No dates yet. Import your data or capture your first deadline.
today.allClear: Nothing urgent in the next 30 days.
today.streak: {n, plural, =0 {Start your streak} one {# day in a row} other {# days in a row}}

say.calm: Nothing urgent today. A good day to move at your pace.

today.appsActive: {n, plural, =0 {none} one {# in progress} other {# in progress}}

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.dragHint: Drag an event to another day to move it. With a keyboard: open it and change the date.

capture.title: Quick capture
capture.placeholder: E.g. IELTS exam Feb 14 at 8 am
capture.hint: Write it your way. Kumo understands “friday 3pm”, “in 2 weeks” or “Feb 28 Beijing time”.
capture.noDate: No date yet: pick one below.

catalog.uniLead: {n} options with score, category and sources. Tap one to see where each number comes from.
catalog.name: Name

reasons.finance: Loses {n} finance points: without a full scholarship it doesn’t fit scenario {s}.
reasons.fit: Loses {n} points: the programs only partly match your interests.
reasons.prestige: Loses {n} prestige points against the top options.

catalog.schLead: {n} scholarships. Estimated dates have a dotted border in the calendar.

ics.title: Your dates in Google Calendar
ics.lead: Subscribe once and your deadlines show up in Google Calendar or your phone’s calendar. It updates by itself.
ics.googleSteps: In Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL → paste the link.
ics.regenerated: Done. The old link no longer works.
ics.warning: Anyone with this link can see your dates. If you shared it by mistake, generate a new one.

list.title: My list
list.lead: This is where you decide. Drag between columns, compare, and keep what you truly want.

stageHelp.shortlist: What caught your eye. No commitment.
stageHelp.pursuing: What you’ll apply to. Kumo guides you with dates and tasks.
stageHelp.discarded: Out, for now. You can bring them back.

list.emptyBody: Go to Explore and tap the cloud on anything that catches your eye. Then compare, weigh and choose.
list.notesPh: What excites you? What worries you?
list.pursuingCount: {n, plural, one {Going for # option} other {Going for # options}}

compare.title: Compare
compare.lead: Side by side. The best value in each row is highlighted.
compare.pick: Pick 2 to 4 options in My list to compare.

media.title: Photos
media.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP. We optimise them before uploading.
media.errType: That file isn’t a supported image.
media.errSize: That image is too heavy even after optimising. Try another.
media.empty: No photos yet. Add the campus, the city, whatever inspires you.

facts.title: Your data
facts.lead: What you discover: real costs, contacts, impressions. Saved with history.
facts.label: Fact
facts.empty: No data of your own yet.
facts.invalidUrl: Check the link: it must start with https://

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: What you need to do for this option. Shows up in Today and the calendar.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: Nothing to show. Add options to your list or clear the filter.
timeline.legend: Bars: application windows. Diamonds: deadlines. Circles: tasks.

study.title: Study
study.lead: Your CSCA route from 0 to 100, the deep-dive library and the channels worth following.
study.rule: Rule: watch the video → do 10 exercises by hand → tick ✓. No exercises, it doesn’t count.
study.searchHint: Search link: paste the exact link once you find it.
study.notesPh: What I understood, what was hard…
study.doneToast: One more step on the route.
study.deepHint: When a route topic hooks you or gets stuck, come here: climb from level 1 (intuition) to 5 (challenge) within the same topic.
study.empty: No library yet. Import your library CSVs in More → Import data.
study.finished: Route complete. On to mock exams.

apps.title: Applications
apps.lead: Every option you mark “Going for it” becomes an application with its checklist.
apps.empty: No applications yet. Mark an option “Going for it” in My list.

docs.title: Documents
docs.lead: Your paperwork vault: status, expiry and notes. Family sees the status, not the content.
docs.name: Document
docs.expiring: Expires in {n} days: renew it early.

recs.title: Recommenders
recs.lead: Who writes your letters, what and by when. Each gets a private link, no account needed.
recs.name: Name
recs.publicTitle: {student} asked you for a recommendation letter

family.title: Family view
family.label: Item
family.tip: Tip: ask “how can I help?” before “have you done…?”

progress.title: Progress
progress.lead: Study hours, mock exams and how you feel. Progress shows when you measure it.
progress.planned: Done: {n} study blocks on your calendar.
progress.planHint: Places blocks from your weekly plan, avoiding what you already have, between 7:00 and 22:00.
progress.trend: Trend: {d, plural, =0 {flat} other {{d} pts per mock}}
progress.noTests: No mock exams yet. Log your first.
progress.overload: Several days of high stress or little sleep. Do only the main thing today; the rest can wait.

focus.title: Focus
focus.subject: What you’ll study
focus.breathe: Breathe. One thing at a time.

model.title: Scoring model
model.lead: Move the weights and watch your ranking change live. Saving creates a new version; the old one stays in history.
model.balance: Your list: {safety} Safety · {target} Target · {reach} Reach · {dream} Dream
model.noSafety: Add at least one Safety to what you’ll apply to.

essays.title: Essays
essays.lead: Your drafts, with versions. The coach doesn’t write for you: it asks and points out.

ai.title: Copilot
ai.lead: Ask Kumo. It answers from your data and suggests; it never changes anything without you.
ai.placeholder: E.g. which universities suit me if I score 80 on the CSCA?
ai.off: Connect your key above to turn on the copilot and essay coach.
ai.error: I couldn’t answer right now. Try again shortly.
ai.keyLead: Paste your Anthropic or OpenRouter key. It’s stored encrypted in your space and never shown again.

calm.title: Just one thing
calm.lead: Breathe with the cloud: in as it grows, out as it shrinks.
